new.text: 7.2.4.11.9 Rte_Rips_NotifyCopyRxData [SWS_Rte_05316] Definition of API function Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyCopyRx Data_<CGI> ⌈ Service Name Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyCopyRxData_<CGI> Syntax BufReq_ReturnType Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyCopyRxData_<CGI> ( CbkHandleIdType ComUserCbkHandleId, const PduInfoType* info, PduLengthType* bufferSizePtr ) Service ID [hex] 0x0108 Sync/Async Synchronous Reentrancy Non Reentrant for same sn, otherwise Reentrant ComUserCbkHandleId Handle Id of the Com user callback invoking the API Parameters (in) info Provides the source buffer (SduDataPtr) and the number of bytes to be copied (SduLength). An SduLength of 0 can be used to query the current amount of available buffer in the upper layer module. In this case, the SduDataPtr may be a NULL_PTR. Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) bufferSizePtr Available receive buffer after data has been copied. Return value BufReq_ReturnType BUFREQ_OK: Data copied successfully. BUFREQ_E_NOT_OK: Data was not copied because an error occurred. ▽ △ Description Rte_Rips_NotifyCopyRxData provides the RTE Implementation Plug-In with the received data of an I-PDU segment from the LdCom signal used for the Data Communication Graph requiring transformation. This function is designed to be a plug-in proxy for the LdCom_TP Rte_LdCom CbkCopyRxData callback. See requirement [SWS_Com_00692] for more details on the functionality of this callback. Available via Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>.h ⌋ [SWS_Rte_05317] Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00300, SRS_Rte_00301, SRS_Rte_00312, SRS_Rte_00317 ⌈The associated Local Software Cluster Communication Plug-In shall provide the Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyCopyRxData_<CGI> Service for each • dataElement instance in an AbstractRequiredPortPrototype of an Atomic Software Component • operation instance in a PortPrototype of an Atomic Software Compo- nent • trigger instance in an AbstractRequiredPortPrototype of an Atomic Software Component IF • for the related Communication Graph the RTE Implementation Plug-In support is enabled AND • a transformation is configured according to [SWS_Rte_08794]. AND • the Communication Graph references an ComIPdu which has its ComIPdu- Type parameter set to TP [SWS_COM_00919]. ⌋ [SWS_Rte_05318] Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00312 ⌈The RTE shall call all Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyCopyRxData_<CGI> Services from the Rte_COMCbkCopyRxData callback for Communication Graphs where • The communication graph references a ComIPdu which has its ComIPduDirec- tion parameter set to COM_RECEIVE [SWS_COM_00919] AND • for the related Communication Graph the RTE Implementation Plug-In support is enabled AND • a transformation is configured according to [SWS_Rte_08794]. ⌋ [SWS_Rte_05319] Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00312 ⌈When a call to an Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyCopyRxData_<CGI> API exists within an Rte_COMCbkCopyRxData callback, the RTE shall pass through the following IN parameters from the outer callback function context as parameters to the Rte_ Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyCopyRxData_<CGI> call: • info The variables passed to the Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyCopyRxData_<CGI> shall be unchanged from the parameters passed to the Rte_COMCbkCopyRxData callback.⌋ [SWS_Rte_05320] Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00312 ⌈When a call to an Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyCopyRxData_<CGI> API exists within an Rte_COMCbkCopyRxData callback, the RTE shall pass through the following OUT parameters from the outer callback function context as parameters to the Rte_ Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyCopyRxData_<CGI> call: • bufferSizePtr ⌋ [SWS_Rte_05321] Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00312 ⌈When a call to an Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyCopyRxData_<CGI> API exists within an Rte_COMCbkCopyRxData callback, the RTE shall ensure that the return value from the Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyCopyRxData_<CGI> call is returned unchanged from the Rte_COMCbkCopyRxData callback. ⌋
